steps.title: Start of shift
steps.show: Open the daily brief, then the inbox: each exception is ranked, with why it is ranked here. Choose one to see it on the map.

steps.title: Find anything
steps.show: Search a SKU, a bin and an order from the search box. The copilot answers and the map shows where.
prompts: Which zone is holding the most inventory?

steps.title: A big outlet order arrives
steps.show: A large order for outlet OUT003 arrives while replenishment runs slow. The stockout risk appears in the inbox and on the map without a reload.
prompts: Which of today's orders are at risk?

steps.title: Investigate
steps.show: Ask the copilot about the exception from the inbox, check the order's status, then acknowledge it.
prompts: Will any products run short for orders due in the next 24 hours?
Which exceptions have the highest impact right now?

steps.title: Time passes
steps.show: Four hours of picks, shipments and receipts happen. Exceptions change and resolve; late orders show as late.
prompts: Which outlet orders shipped late or are overdue?

steps.title: Next morning
steps.show: A new daily brief for the new day, with yesterday's throughput against the average.
prompts: Show me the top 5 fastest-moving items.

steps.title: The festival approaches
steps.show: A week passes. Demand ramps up for the festival, low stock rises and days of cover fall.
prompts: Which items are running low on stock?
How many days of cover do we have for the beverages category?

steps.title: Ask anything
steps.show: Ask your own questions. The copilot answers what its tools cover and declines honestly when a question is out of scope.
prompts: Are slow movers sitting in the fast-pick zone?
Which items have not moved in the last 30 days?
